title: Topology Optimisation
description: Let the mathematics decide where material goes: fill a cell only if it carries load. Structures come out like bone. Unlocks a cheaper Metamaterial Sheet.

puzzle.goal: Each cell of a design holds a share r of material. Write its stiffness Y, from the solid's E and the empty cell's m, with the share raised to a power p, so half-filled cells are not worth keeping.
puzzle.name: Penalised density
puzzle.ask: Find Y for r = @{r}, p = 3, E = @{E} and m = @{m}.
puzzle.method: Raising the share to a power above one makes half a cell give an eighth of the stiffness: the optimiser stops using it.
